author: Reanimated
text_post: For most of October, I've been going to Philadelphia for various events and my GPS always takes me towards the Sugarhouse Casino section.  I've hit a red light every single time traveling there.  While I'm waiting at the red light, there is always the same homeless couple there.  They appear to be in their mid 20's and have the same tactic of writing that they are combat vets on a cardboard sign and that they are homeless and need money.  I see a ton of homeless people when I'm in New York City and they are all isolated and usually just scream crazy shit at me.  I don't see many homeless people in Philly. This Philadelphia couple actually makes me feel bad about my incel/love-shy situation.  I didn't want to pull my iPhone out and snap a picture of them so I could later rate them on the looks scale but I'm guessing the guy is pretty good looking.  The guy has no money and no status yet I'm sure he is banging that girl behind some dumpster several times a day while I am still all alone and unloved in this world.  Do you think that this homeless girl would ever find any type of value in any of us incel/love-shy people here and dump the homeless guy and fall in love with us instead?  Or are we really at rock bottom at this point that even a homeless girl wouldn't fuck us or love us?
